title: Listen and Choose a Response — Neighbors

questions.stem: Could I borrow your ladder to clean my gutters this afternoon?

options.A: I cleaned my room this afternoon.
options.B: Sure, it's in the garage, so just knock when you come.
options.C: The ladder is about six feet tall.
options.D: I'd like to borrow it as well.

questions.explanation: The request is granted with practical instructions. The other choices repeat 'clean', describe the ladder, or answer as if the speaker were also borrowing.
